div.div: 4 ادمنهُ , (T, S, M, Msb, K,) inf. n. إِدْمَانٌ, (Msb,) He did it continually, or perpetually: (S, K:) he kept, or clave, to it (T, M, Msb, TA) without desisting from it, or without quitting it, (M,) constantly, perseveringly, or assiduously, (Msb,) or inseparably; (TA;) namely, drinking, (T,) and wine, (T, M,) &c. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
